items.headline: Houthis renew warning against using Riyadh's King Khalid airport — Saree: airport remains a 'military target', operations targeting it will continue; airport designates Terminal 1 domestic / Terminal 2 international from Sunday (Reuters, Oct 24)

France protests largely peaceful — 410k marched nationwide (unions claim ~2x), 110k in Paris; evening clashes in Paris/Marseille and other cities, but less intense than Oct 17 as 70k police held the line; 135 arrests by early afternoon (Reuters, Oct 24)

Moody's spared France: Aa3 affirmed, outlook stays negative — defying the widely expected one-notch cut to A1; wants a deficit-cutting 2027 budget, sees debt >120% of GDP in 2027; S&P reviews France Nov 27 (Le Monde/Reuters, Oct 23)

Brent settled $116.72 (+3.1% Friday, +6.2% week — highest close since April 29); WTI $103.27 (+3.8%, 22-week high) — Houthi attacks on Saudi energy assets + Iran tanker strikes (marketbriefer/WSJ, Oct 23)
Trump at Florida rally: US may do 'another little Epic Fury' against Iran; envoy Barrack: weekend strike 'absolutely' possible; US withdrew some diplomatic staff/relatives from Saudi Arabia (Oct 23)
DXY 101.81 (+0.2% Friday); 10Y 5.00% (+4bp), 2Y 4.69%, 30Y 5.33% — yields reversed part of Thursday's haven rally on hot PMIs + oil (marketbriefer/el-fondo, Oct 23)
Gold closed $3,995.81 (-0.7% Friday, -4.1% week) — first close below $4,000 since July; failed to rally on the risk-off tape as Treasuries/yen/franc took the haven bid (marketbriefer/ING, Oct 23)

USD/CAD 1.40026 (7th straight daily loonie gain) — dipped to 1.39684 intraday before closing back above 1.40; WSJ/Reuters tariff-removal story unconfirmed (White House: speculation) (forexcommand/el-fondo, Oct 23)
